steel.title: Watch Market Report: Submariner and Royal Oak Lead Steel Demand
steel.excerpt: Steel sports models drew most of the attention from traders this period.
steel.content:
Traders spent most of the day on steel sports models. The Rolex Submariner Date 126610LN was the most discussed reference, and the AP Royal Oak came up in several posts about asking prices.

Based on activity from October 6 to October 7, 2026.

Key takeaway: Steel sports watches dominated. Buyers & sellers stayed close on Submariner pricing.

Activity
Busy

Most mentioned
Submariner Date

Mood
Steady

The Submariner Date holds the spotlight

Several posts compared asking prices for the Submariner Date 126610LN with listings on Chrono24. Traders described the gap as narrow.

A couple of posts said full sets with box & papers sold faster than watch-only examples.

AP Royal Oak and the Black Bay 58

The AP Royal Oak drew steady interest. Traders said the "Jumbo" remains hard to find.

The Tudor Black Bay 58 was described as the usual pick for buyers with a budget under $4,000.

Trust and safety

Traders flagged a pattern of cheap replica offers sent by direct message.

Tip: meet in a public place or use an escrow service for high-value deals.

That is the picture for the day. The next report follows tomorrow.

This report describes community sentiment and activity. It is not an appraisal, price quote or financial advice.

dress.title: Weekly Watch Market Report: Dress Watches Gain Ground
dress.excerpt: Dress watches from JLC and A. Lange & Söhne took a larger share of the conversation this week.
dress.content:
Dress watches took a larger share of the conversation this week. The JLC Reverso Tribute and the Lange 1 from A. Lange & Söhne led the discussion.

Based on activity from September 30 to October 7, 2026.

Key takeaway: Interest moved toward smaller, thinner dress pieces. The Patek Philippe Nautilus 5711/1A was mentioned less than the week before.

Activity
Moderate

Most mentioned
Reverso Tribute

Mood
Curious

Reverso and Lange 1 lead

Traders compared the JLC Reverso Tribute with the Lange 1 in several posts. Most of the discussion was about case size and wearability.

One post asked whether the Grand Seiko "Snowflake" belongs in the same conversation. Replies said the GS Snowflake is a sports-dress hybrid.

Nautilus talk cools

The Patek Philippe Nautilus 5711/1A came up in fewer posts than the week before.

A single post mentioned an eBay auction ending without a sale.

Trust and safety

Tip: ask for a timestamped photo before paying a deposit.

The next weekly report follows in seven days.

quiet.title: Watch Market Report: Quiet Day as Traders Focus on Safe Deals
quiet.excerpt: A quiet day in which traders mostly talked about shipping and payment safety.
quiet.content:
It was a quiet day. Traders mostly talked about insured shipping and how to approach deals that look too cheap.

Based on activity from October 7 to October 8, 2026.

Key takeaway: Few models were discussed. Shipping and payment safety took most of the attention.

Activity
Quiet

Most mentioned
Shipping

Mood
Cautious

Shipping questions

Several posts asked how to insure a parcel for international delivery. Traders said they prefer tracked services with a signature on delivery.

Payment safety

A couple of posts warned that cheap prices paired with pressure to pay quickly are a common pattern.

Tip: pay with a method that offers buyer protection, and never send a deposit before you see the watch on a video call.

The next report follows tomorrow.

This report describes community sentiment and activity. It is not an appraisal, price quote or financial advice.
